title: Compute-Shader Partikelsystem — Act I Overlay + Transition
detail: ✅ Vollständig: GPU physics (gravity, damping, wind), 32k particle pool, update + render pipeline. Compute dispatch mit timeline-aware uniforms. Point sprite rendering mit additive blend. Integration in Renderer (init, update, render, shutdown). TODO: Emission spawning für Act I neural pulse.

title: Act I → Act II Crossfade Shader
detail: ✅ Grundgerüst: Timeline::transition_progress() für Fenster-Detektion, Renderer dual-act blending, crossfade.frag shader. Dual-pass rendering mit alpha fade-in. TODO: Smooth dissolve pattern refinement.

title: WebM Render-Export Flag (--capture)
detail: ✅ CLI-Flag integriert (--capture audio.wav). Frame counter + logging. Scaffold für glReadPixels + PNG encode. TODO: libpng integration oder PPM fallback, ffmpeg WebM encoding.

title: Particle Emission System — Neural Pulse Emitter
detail: ✅ Beat-synced emission: 150 particles per downbeat in Act I. Spherical distribution, radial velocity + upward bias. Color palette magenta→cyan over beat phase. Lifetime 1.2s. Integrated into render loop.

title: Frame Capture Pipeline (glReadPixels → PPM/WebM)
detail: ✅ Vollständig: FrameCapture class (src/capture/), glReadPixels per frame, PPM format (Portable Pixelmap, no external deps), automatic vertical flip, ffmpeg command generation for VP9 WebM encode. Usage: --capture audio.wav → ./captures/frame_*.ppm → ffmpeg → hypersynapse.webm.

title: Post-FX Pipeline Refinement (Bloom, Vignette, Grading)
detail: ✅ Act-adaptive post.frag: CA 0.8x→1.5x, bloom threshold 0.80→0.65, radius 5→10px, scanlines 4%→12%, grain 0.03→0.08, vignette power 1.5→3.5. Beat-reactive kick on snare. Result: subtle Act I → intense Act II → chaotic Act III visual progression.
